import React from 'react'; import { useApp } from '../context/AppContext'; export default function SystemPerf() { const { systemStats, wsConnected } = useApp(); const bars = [ { label: 'CPU Usage', val: systemStats.cpu_usage || 0, color: '#3b82f6' }, { label: 'Memory Usage', val: systemStats.memory_usage || 0, color: '#f97316' }, ]; return (
System Performance
{bars.map((b, i) => (
{b.label} {b.val.toFixed(1)}%
))}
FPS
{systemStats.fps || 0}
Storage
{systemStats.storage_used} / {systemStats.storage_total} GB
Network
{systemStats.network_mbps || 0} Mbps
{wsConnected ? '● Live' : '● Off'} v1.0.0
); }
